title: Alphageddon
description:
In Alphageddon, you are the creator of a planet infested by pesky bugs, also known as human beings. Your only option is to, then, make sure they are killed off and removed from your perfect creation. They won't give up that easily, though...

Alphageddon is a short experimental game, where all levels brings you different game play mechanics, mixing storytelling, fast reflexes, strategy and lots of fire and destruction.

The game is divided into 6 levels:

 • 3 main stories episodes
 
• 2 harder arcade modes that you can play for as long as you want
 
• 1 secret level
description_short: Throw asteroids on them, raise their sea levels and even make the whole moon fall on their heads! This is only a fraction of what you'll have to do to make sure your perfect creation is safe in this game mixing fast reflexes, strategy and lots of fire and destruction.
